note: A download URL is present only when the named file was in the artifact directory and copied to the publish directory. Store listings are not used. komboe-android-debug.apk is refused. Public files are served from https://komboe.com/downloads/ .

assets.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
assets.install: No extension store listing. Unzip the file and load it unpacked (chrome://extensions, edge://extensions, or the Chromium equivalent). The same zip is what Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, and Cerebro load.
assets.reason: The clients image has not published komboe-chrome-mv3.zip into this vault.

assets.name: Browser extension (Firefox)
assets.install: No add-ons listing. Load the zip as a temporary add-on from about:debugging.
assets.reason: No komboe-firefox.zip is in the release artifacts.

assets.name: Browser extension (Safari)
assets.install: Safari requires a macOS + Xcode build. There is no Linux CI artifact.
assets.reason: No Safari extension build. A macOS + Xcode build is required and is not set up.

assets.name: Desktop for Windows
assets.install: Unsigned testing installer. Windows SmartScreen will warn.
assets.reason: No verified current Windows installer. Older unsigned builds are not offered.

assets.name: Linux (AppImage, updates itself)
assets.install: Primary Linux download. This AppImage checks https://komboe.com/downloads/desktop/latest-linux.yml on any connection and updates itself.
assets.reason: No verified current Linux AppImage. Older unsigned builds are not offered.

assets.name: Linux (.deb)
assets.install: Package install. When a new build is published, Komboe downloads that .deb, checks its sha256, and installs it with pkexec and apt. If that cannot run, the prompt switches you to the AppImage, which updates itself.
assets.reason: No verified current Linux .deb. Older unsigned builds are not offered.

assets.name: Desktop for macOS
assets.reason: No macOS build. Apple signing and notarization are not set up.

assets.name: Android
assets.install: Sideload this APK and allow installs from this source if Android asks. After the first install, the app checks for updates from this page over Wi-Fi or mobile data. Settings → About → Check for updates also works. It is signed with the Komboe debug key, so it upgrades the existing sideload.

assets.name: iPhone and iPad
assets.reason: No iOS build, App Store listing, or TestFlight. There is no QR code.

assets.name: Command line (Linux x64)
assets.install: Unzip and put `komboe` on your PATH. Set the server URL before signing in. The CLI update command only contacts a host when KOMBOE_CLI_RELEASES_URL is set.
assets.reason: No CLI zip is in the release artifacts.

assets.name: Wear OS
assets.install: The Wear OS companion is a scaffold. The phone app stays the vault authority. A watch build is not published.
assets.reason: No Wear OS APK. The companion is a scaffold and is not published.

assets.name: Apple Watch
assets.reason: No Apple Watch app. A watchOS build is not set up.
